banks.title: Chapter 1: Mole Concept
banks.subject: Chemistry

banks.title: Motion: Distance, Displacement, Speed and Velocity
banks.subject: Physics
banks.description: Introductory questions on distance, displacement, average speed and average velocity.

banks.title: Equations of motion with constant acceleration
banks.subject: Physics
banks.instructions: Assume straight-line motion, with acceleration constant within each described stage. Use signed velocity and displacement. Distance is the total path length.
banks.description: Level 1 and Level 2 practice with the three equations for straight-line motion at constant acceleration.

banks.title: Motion Graphs: Displacement, Velocity and Acceleration
banks.subject: Physics
banks.instructions: Motion is along one straight line. The coordinate x is signed position (displacement from a fixed origin); displacement over an interval is the change in x. Treat the labelled graph values as exact. Straight segments are linear. In the curved x–t graph, use the marked tangent for instantaneous velocity.
banks.description: Twenty graph-based MCQs: ten x–t and ten v–t questions on velocity, acceleration, displacement and average velocity, with hints and worked solutions.
